title: Incentives
coreMove: Read the behavior the incentive actually buys, not the behavior the designer hoped it would buy.
sourcePressure: Incentives steer behavior through reward, penalty, signal, and consequence inside systems.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: treating incentives as bribes or simple motivation

hook: opening with a definition of Incentives
counterintuition: treating incentives as bribes or simple motivation
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about it
audit your life with no chapter-specific object
examples: same dashboard meeting with swapped names
kitchen-table family argument unless the domain requires it
teacher and student scene used as default proof

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
